title: Phantasm II
description:
S1
Two psychically linked teens (James LeGros, Paula Irvine) cannot escape from the grave-robbing Tall Man of their nightmares.

title: Psycho IV: The Beginning
description:
S1
Norman Bates (Anthony Perkins) phones a talk show and recalls his life as a 1940s teenager (Henry Thomas) warped by his mother (Olivia Hussey).

title: Rosewood Lane
description:
S1
Sonny Blake (Rose McGowan), a radio talk show therapist, moves back to her childhood home after her father dies. She is shocked to learn her neighbors are terrified of the paperboy (Daniel Ross Owens) who turns out to be a dangerous sociopath.

title: Saint Ange
description:
S1
Strange events haunt a pregnant woman (Virginie Ledoyen) and others at a recently vacated orphanage in the French Alps.

title: Session 9
description:
S1
Asbestos removal crews start work in an abandoned insane asylum, and strange happenings begin to occur.

title: SiREN
description:
S1
A man visits a supernatural nightclub during his bachelor party and inadvertently crosses paths with a dancer who is actually a terrifying, legendary creature.

title: The Skulls
description:
S1
A freshman (Joshua Jackson) joins an elite society that will guarantee him success, but he questions his decision when his reporter roommate dies mysteriously.

title: The Skulls II
description:
S1
A new inductee (Robin Dunne) into the secret society witnesses a murder at the hands of one of its members.
